objective: 持续寻找可便宜证伪、有源码依据、可进入人工验证的小型开源贡献；优先排除重复、陈旧问题与无实际收益方向。

repos.question: Inspect real-input API boundaries and kernel correctness. Existing Quack PR #161 and varlen layout docs are known work. Do not repeat the rejected ceil-offset/token-padding recipe or mixed FP8-grouped versus BF16-loop performance claim.

Find bounded correctness, unsupported-configuration diagnostics, or boundary-test opportunities. PR #2902 already addresses SM120 SharedStorage validation. Distinguish supported production execution from hypothetical configurations; never assume a reported issue is current or unclaimed.

Find small production-reachable correctness or host-overhead opportunities. Avoid backend rewrites and eager-to-graph extrapolation. Demand exact source context and a cheap falsification plan; no performance or Ready claims without execution.
